summary: Narrow frontend-only check of the iter113 presentation fixes. I ran the compiled dev-preview React app (public URL) against the TEST-ONLY isolated bridge (iso_bridge_bitsat_iter113.py, port 8765, DB tejas_isolated_iter105_test). /api/auth/session was mocked with meta.api_version='1'. Results were first graded with GET (202, then 200). I did not rerun the backend, the source crawl or the rank tests. ALL FIXES VERIFIED IN THE ACTUAL PREVIEW DOM at 1920x800 and 390x844. (1) Cutoff number: the DOM is 308 / 390. The number wrapper computes to 32px (text box 38px tall) and the unit to 13px. (2) Alternatives: each row is .bitsat-campus-row with display:flex and justify-content:space-between, 343px wide on desktop and 274px on mobile. They render as separate rows, e.g. 'K K Birla Goa ... 274' and 'Hyderabad ... 272'. (3) Header: the h2 letter-spacing is -0.3px and the eyebrow is 11px on desktop and mobile. (4) Grammar: at 309 the first card is Pilani CS 308 with '+1 mark above' and the heading reads '3 distinct programmes for 309 marks'. At 300 the first card is MNC Pilani 299 with '+1 mark above' and alternatives Goa 270 and Hyderabad 268. Card 3 is CS Goa 274 (+26) with Hyderabad 272. At 204 the next targets read '1 more mark', '4 more marks' and '16 more marks'. At 205 the heading is '1 distinct programme', with the count '1 programme within...'. The mock 310 default is unchanged (3 cards, 12 programmes). (5) Home sheen: the JEE ::before peak computes to rgba(255,255,255,0.25) and its static cap to 0.03. BITSAT is unchanged at 0.47. JEE bg is rgb(176,0,0), BITSAT bg is rgb(255,153,51) with ink rgb(43,22,0), COMEDK is rgb(16,17,21), and the All India .flagship-banner is #0B2D80 in the CSS. White text over the peak (#B00000 + 25% white) is about 5.2:1, which passes AA. The sweep moves without hover on 390 mobile (translateX -87 to 218 to 437 to 498 in about 1.8s) and on desktop. Pause freezes the transform and sets aria-pressed=true. With reduced motion the animation and display are none and the toggle is hidden. Horizontal overflow is 0 on every page and viewport. Cleanup: bridge stopped and test DB dropped (verified absent). No real DB or auth writes.
test_credentials: No real login. TEST-ONLY x-test-user:student via a bridge route plus a mocked /api/auth/session envelope.
seed_data_creation: Only in isolated DB tejas_isolated_iter105_test (seeded by the bridge, dropped afterwards).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bridge flow is the same as in iter113. The browser_automation tool saves screenshots under /root/.emergent/automation_output/<ts>/, so copy them into /app/test_reports afterwards. Use the /home route for the exam cards; the All India blue lives in live-series.css .flagship-banner.
